picks.reasoning: Stats are for spreadsheet kids. T1 has the one player who takes games over by himself, and Faker's lane dominance wins knockout series. Fade the hype on BLG.
Early game is everything, and KC's +1.1k GD@15 over 38 games is the best tempo in the field. They rush first drake, own the map and snowball before anyone wakes up.
Fearless strips comfort picks, and T1's bench of flexible champions plus Faker's late-game drafting make them the team that adapts best. They're 9-4 against other regions.
GEN tops the board on series, game win rate and results against other regions. I only lean this hard because they win 74% of their games and no one else matches that.
The numbers are wobbly, but T1 keeps winning the tense series, and that's a room that knows how to hold together when Worlds gets loud; I'm backing the feeling.
